title: Tactical Powerless Amebas

Teh clan.

== History ==
The clan was most active circa [[1998|'98]]-[[1999|'99]], followed by an inactive 6 years and a comeback in [[2008]] with semiactiviness. The clan also expanded into many other games. Clan was "active" in Quake Live & World of Warcraft, but not anymore.
